verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own data-export capability: raw analytical data access for custom reporting and data pipelines, and export into BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker. Nothing shows this covers all account data, uses open file formats, or is meant for full account offboarding. The read API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented full-account export, named open formats (e.g. CSV/JSON), coverage of attachments/comments/all objects, offboarding/portability guidance, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export Wrike data into BI tools like Tableau, Power BI, or Looker for advanced analytics.
Access raw analytical data from your Wrike workspace for custom reporting and data pipelines.
